Keep Local Product Intent—Add Marriott Bonvoy: retain Renaissance Hotels's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Upper-upscale discovery: navigators programming, destination discovery cues, and Marriott Bonvoy distribution for curious travelers.

Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
